image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) adhering to a rocky, algae-covered substrate. The organism displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal shell plates embedded in a textured, leathery girdle. The surrounding environment includes encrusting coralline algae and small marine growths.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Anterior end is blunt and indistinct.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front of the animal tapers slightly but remains blunt and integrated with the girdle, matching the description.
No antennae, eyestalks, or other sensory appendages are present on the head region.
